label: emptyActionFails: the empty-action check is dropped, so a Button with {} passes
baselineOnlyListed: the baseline is read as allow-all, so an unlisted placeholder passes
liveReasonPasses: any .disabled( counts as constant, so a live reason fails
staleBaselineFails: a baseline line whose hit is gone is ignored, so the baseline can grow stale
unusedCommandsSkipped: a Commands type no scene builds still counts, so a stub left on disk fails
find: guard let owner = site.owner else { return true }
replace: guard let owner = site.owner, owner.isEmpty else { return true }
